summary.intent: Plan and execute CipherBox Phase 49 (shared-folder intra-share move, useFolderNavigation consolidation, batch/drag move parity), run the full PR-QA pipeline (simplify, security reviews, CodeRabbit CLI + GitHub, push, PR), then verify phases 47–49 and mark them complete.
summary.outcome: PR #509 was created, passed CI-E2E on web and all three desktop OSes, and was merged to main. Along the way the session expanded scope to include write-key distribution for share descendants and a full re-architecture of IPNS caching from per-user-keyed to signature-gated/name-keyed. All three phases (47, 48, 49) were verified and marked Complete via `phase complete`.

repo: SelectionActionBar must be gated on `selectedIds.size > 1` (not `> 0`), matching the private-vault FileBrowser pattern. Gating on `> 0` causes the bar to pop in on the first click of a double-click, shifting rows and breaking folder navigation.
Web package has no `typecheck` npm script; the correct gate is `pnpm --filter @cipherbox/web exec tsc -b`.

SDK `dist/` is gitignored and CI rebuilds it. When public SDK API changes between execution waves, `pnpm --filter @cipherbox/sdk build` must be run before the web wave or web tsc will see stale type declarations.

CodeRabbit on this repo posts nitpicks in the review body, not as inline thread comments, so GraphQL `reviewThreads` returns 0 unresolved threads even when there are actionable findings — the review body must be parsed separately.

`collectChildKeys` in `apps/web/src/lib/crypto/key-wrapping.ts` previously emitted only read keys (`folder`/`file`) for descendants even on write shares. Needed a `permission: 'read' | 'write'` param to emit `folder-ipns`/`file-ipns` on write shares; `FilePointer.ipnsPrivateKeyEncrypted` is optional and must be guarded before emitting `file-ipns`.

The IPNS publish/resolve stack uses the server DB as source-of-truth (synchronous DB write first, DHT fire-and-forget). `folder_ipns` was previously unique on `(userId, ipnsName)` — a non-owner publish forked a duplicate row. Re-keyed to `(ipnsName)` with server-side Ed25519 signature verification; authority is now key possession, not share ownership. Tradeoff: revocation now requires IPNS key rotation rather than a server-side revoke.

The `ipns` npm package (`validate` from `ipns/validator`, `unmarshalIPNSRecord`, `extractPublicKeyFromIPNSRecord`) provides server-side verification. `@cipherbox/crypto` already has all required deps; the hand-rolled API parser was deleted.
`extractPublicKeyFromIPNSRecord` returns `undefined` synchronously (not a rejected promise) for identity-key records — it must be wrapped in try/catch, not `.catch()`.

Desktop E2E conflict-detection helpers (`.sh`/`.ps1`) faked a competing device by POSTing a dummy unsigned bytes record to `/ipns/publish`. That worked when the server did no validation but broke under the new signature gate. Only Windows surfaced it because `.ps1` throws on failure while `.sh` only logs a warning.

The `phase complete` CLI command safely updates ROADMAP and STATE without truncation risk. `phase uat-passed` is listed in help but has no handler. The `human_needed` warning after `phase complete` is a false positive from the regex matching `previous_status: human_needed` history lines in frontmatter.

`CHILD_KEY_TYPES` in `apps/api/src/shares/types.ts` is the single source of truth for both `@IsIn` validation and `@ApiProperty enum` on `ChildKeyDto`. Adding a value there automatically propagates to the generated client after `pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api generate:client`.
The GSD `gsd-tools commit helper` reports false negatives (`commit_failed`) while commits actually land — always verify via `git log` rather than trusting the helper's exit status.

code.finding: Private-vault SelectionActionBar is gated on `selectedIds.size > 1`. SharedFileBrowser was initially gated on `> 0`, which caused the mid-double-click layout-shift regression fixed in commit 4bb181995.

enumerateSharedSubtree writability check requires a per-subfolder `share_keys` row with `keyType: 'folder-ipns'`. Without write-key distribution this always returned `writable: false` for owner-created subfolders.
enumerateSharedSubtree DFS iteration must zero each per-iteration `folderKey` in a try/finally (security fix). Each node now also returns `parentId` to enable descendant exclusion in the move dialog.
Unique constraint was `@Unique(['userId', 'ipnsName'])`. Changed to `@Unique(['ipnsName'])` so one canonical row exists per IPNS name and any authenticated holder of the key can update it.

`findActiveWriteShare` was an exact `ipnsName` match against top-level write Share rows. This blocked recipients from publishing descendant subfolders. Removed in favour of signature-gated `upsertFolderIpns` with anti-rollback (embedded sequence must not regress).

Folder branch accessed `folder.ipnsPrivateKeyEncrypted` unconditionally while the file branch (line 72) guards it. Although the field is typed required on `FolderEntry`, a defensive guard is needed to protect against malformed legacy metadata.

Used `throw` on failed bump (unlike .sh which only warns), causing the Windows job to fail under the new server-side signature gate. Both runners now call `bump-ipns-sequence.mjs` which republishes with a real signed record.
`extractPublicKeyFromIPNSRecord` returns undefined synchronously (not rejected) for identity-key records. The helper must use try/catch around the await, not `.catch()`.

workflow: Run GSD executors sequentially (not in parallel worktrees) for AFK/unattended sessions. Parallel worktrees require manual merge-back coordination that is error-prone to automate; sequential execution also prevents concurrent test runs from starving RAM.

When running multiple GSD verifier agents in parallel, forbid each from re-running test suites. Run suites once centrally/sequentially from the orchestrator and inject the results as evidence — prevents RAM contention and duplicate work.

The pre-commit `check-api-client.sh` hook fires only when DTO/entity/controller files AND generated files both have unstaged changes. Stage and commit in the right order: generated-client commit first, then the dependent commit, to avoid one non-building intermediate.

Dispatch `workflow_dispatch` ci-e2e after every significant fix rather than waiting for PR-merge; the run validates integration earlier and the ~15-min cost is lower than diagnosing a late merge-gate failure.

The `ipns` npm package (already a dep of `@cipherbox/core`) provides `validate`, `unmarshalIPNSRecord`, and `extractPublicKeyFromIPNSRecord`. Prefer it over hand-rolled parsers; validates both format correctness and Ed25519 signature authenticity in one call.

When adding a security gate (e.g. mandatory signature verification) to a shared API path, audit all test helpers and integration scripts that simulate competing actors — they often produce fake payloads that will break under the new gate.

CodeRabbit's CHILL profile does not auto-post an incremental re-review on every push. After resolving its findings, poll once after ~5 min; if no new review appears, treat the 0-unresolved-threads state as final.

friction: All commits were unsigned (GPG signing disabled for AFK session) — the repo enforces signed commits on PRs, requiring a signed rebase or admin override before merge.
The GSD `gsd-tools commit helper` reported `commit_failed` while commits actually landed; required manual `git log` verification to confirm success.

Pre-commit hook ordering constraint: `git rm` on the hand-rolled parser was already staged when the write-key distribution commit ran, making commit A non-building in isolation (CI runs on final HEAD so it was accepted, but messy history).

The Desktop Windows E2E failure surfaced three ci-e2e runs into the session — the dummy-record conflict helper only failed on Windows because `.ps1` throws while `.sh` logs a warning, masking the issue on macOS/Linux.
The `uat-passed` subcommand is listed in `gsd-tools` help output but has no handler; the workaround was editing VERIFICATION.md frontmatter directly then calling `phase complete`.

The `phase complete` CLI emits a spurious `human_needed` warning when the VERIFICATION.md frontmatter contains `previous_status: human_needed` in its history block, even when current status is `passed`.
JSX comment syntax: placing `{/* comment */}` inside a `{condition && (...)}` single-child expression caused TS1005; comment had to be moved to the outer JSX level.
Vitest mock call tuple typing: `(c[1] as { itemId: string })` failed because the mock call tuple is typed `[]`; required `(c as unknown as [string, { itemId: string }])[1]`.
Background watch script crashed with 'read-only variable' because it used `status` as a shell variable name, which is reserved in zsh.
The CI E2E watch script timed out on the third run (the full IPNS re-architecture run took >14 min), requiring a manual status check after the notification arrived.
open_items: Migrate desktop E2E helper scripts from `.mjs` to TypeScript (todo filed at `.planning/todos/pending/2026-06-18-migrate-mjs-e2e-helper-scripts-to-typescript.md`). Untyped helpers skip tsc/eslint and only fail deep in single-OS E2E runs.

Full authoritative SDK subtree cycle-guard: the current guard is UI-side (descendant exclusion in SharedMoveDialog) + SDK self-move-throw, but a crafted direct client call could still move a folder into a descendant. Deferred because the actor already holds write keys; noted in PR description.
Client-side `signatureVerified` enforcement on resolve responses (noted in PR as fast-follow to the decentralized IPNS model).
Un-cached-name resolve verification: `resolveRecord` should verify the signature on cache-miss DHT fetches (noted in PR).
Batch key-refetch performance: `batchMoveItemsHandler` refetches share keys on every iteration. Deferred as parity-acceptable for v1.
DFS concurrency for `enumerateSharedSubtree`: currently sequential; could fan out per child. Deferred due to gateway rate-limit tradeoff.

Write access revocation now requires IPNS key rotation + re-share (server-side revoke was removed with the per-user keying). This is an accepted architectural tradeoff but should be documented in the security model.
`useMultiSelect` extraction as a shared hook (both private FileBrowser and SharedFileBrowser implement their own selection state). Deferred as cross-boundary scope creep beyond Phase 49.

Cargo.lock sync to match released crate versions was included in the verify-phase branch commit but was the result of a release-please commit landing without regenerating the lock file — not Phase 49 work.
